build_Pascal2GoliathDataset: build a Pascal2GoliathDataset instance to load PASCAL human parsing images and segmentations mapped to Goliath classes
create_apply_color_palette: create a colored segmentation map by applying the PASCAL color palette to a label array
test_load_data_list: test the Pascal2GoliathDataset load_data_list method to verify it discovers all segmentation files in the directory
review_get_data_info: review the Pascal2GoliathDataset get_data_info method to understand how PASCAL labels are converted to Goliath format
summarize_SOURCE_TO_TARGET_MAPPING: summarize the SOURCE_TO_TARGET_MAPPING dictionary that maps PASCAL source class indices to Goliath target class indices
